sources.label: Official Animal Men's Size Guide, Tops (chest/waist ranges, cm)

audit: Old /size-guide/ 404s; guide is /pages/mens-size-guide. Tops chart prints chest and waist ranges in cm (and inches) for XXS-4XL. S 91/77 -> 90-96/76-82; M 97/83 -> 96-102/82-88; XL 109/95 -> 110-118/96-104; XXL 115/101 -> 118-126/104-112. XS, 3XL, 4XL added; XXS not stored (printed as open-ended '<84' / '<70'). UK/US/EU removed (not printed; old 'UK 36' etc. were conventions). Page doesn't say 'body' in words; ranges per size are body sizes.
